title: SASSA Grant Status Check Guide
description: Check what your SASSA grant application status means and what to do next.

seo.metaTitle: SASSA Grant Status Meanings — Complete Guide
seo.metaDescription: Learn what every SASSA status means: Pending, Processing, Approved, Declined, and more. Know what to do at each stage.

contentBlocks.text: Your SASSA application goes through several status stages. Each one tells you where your application is in the review process and what action you may need to take.
